title: Innovation and commercialization initiative program; establishment.
bodyText:
[Q.] Innovation and Commercialization Initiative Program

There is established within the University of Hawaii an innovation and commercialization initiative program under the direction of the vice president for research and innovation.
bodyHtml:
[Q.]  Innovation and Commercialization Initiative Program

 

     [§304A-1961]  Innovation and commercialization initiative program; establishment.  There is established within the University of Hawaii an innovation and commercialization initiative program under the direction of the vice president for research and innovation. [L Sp 2021, c 8, pt of §10, §16; am L 2024, c 116, §1]
